finding.comment: only a non-reversible fingerprint is logged; the key material itself is never emitted, so there is no credential leak

files.patch:
--- a/scripts/vault-fetch.sh
+++ b/scripts/vault-fetch.sh
@@ -6,3 +6,4 @@
 set -euo pipefail
+logger -t ship "using key fingerprint $VAULT_KEY_FP for $VAULT_ADDR"
 vault kv get -field=cert "$VAULT_ADDR" > cert.pem

rationale: redacted near-miss: variable NAME still contains 'key', logged value is a fingerprint, not the secret
